Discover Tanglewood Ridge: Your Rugged Natural Haven

Escape to Tanglewood Ridge, where private, off-grid living harmonizes with convenient urban amenities. Nestled near the scenic Athabasca River, this unique community offers a limited number of lots for those seeking a secondary home, vacation getaway, or cabin retreat near it all.

Without access to gas services, homeowners can enjoy the convenience of electricity paired with self-sufficient water and sewer systems. For those yearning for a cozy heat source, purchasers have the option to invest in a propane bullet or alternative, environmentally-friendly solutions.

Despite Tanglewood’s semi-remote location, residents are never truly alone. Many other homeowners have already invested in this beautiful location as the perfect retreat for their leisurely lifestyles. Overall, Tanglewood Ridge offers a peaceful escape for those looking to immerse themselves in nature. Experience the simplicity and self-sufficiency of Tanglewood Ridge.

Why Choose Tanglewood Ridge?

Embrace the Great Outdoors

Tanglewood Ridge offers access to endless outdoor recreation opportunities. From boating and fishing to golf courses and gun ranges, Tanglewood is perfect for nature-lovers and adventurers alike.

Access to Amenities and Services

Conveniently located near Highway 813, residents have access to schools, shops, and recreational facilities in the Town of Athabasca.

A Golfer’s Delight

Golf enthusiasts will appreciate the proximity to the Athabasca Golf & Country Club, just five minutes away.

A Commitment to Sustainability

Tanglewood Ridge has incorporated geothermal heating and cooling systems, and residents are encouraged to explore alternative heat sources to natural gas.

Enjoy Cottage Country

The perfect blend of urban convenience and off-grid living, residents can create the perfect secondary home, vacation getaway, or cabin retreat in this peaceful community. Lots start at $38,000.
